summary: GarmentAddForm + DeleteRowButton wiring for Изделия matches tech-spec Decisions 2/3/5 and Task 2's handler/validation contracts exactly. Enter-interception claim verified correct in the actual DOM structure (outer <form onSubmit={handleSaveSettings}> at Panel.jsx:1234-1457 wraps both Изделия SettingsSection blocks at 1273/1337; GarmentAddForm is a plain <div>, so an un-intercepted Enter in the Название input would bubble to and submit the outer form — the onKeyDown+preventDefault container handler correctly blocks this). No issues found.

claims_verified.claim: type="button" + manual onKeyDown Enter-interception instead of real <form>, because nested forms are invalid HTML and Enter would otherwise submit the outer settings form
claims_verified.evidence: Panel.jsx:1234 `<form className="space-y-5" onSubmit={handleSaveSettings}>` ... closes at Panel.jsx:1457. Both Изделия SettingsSection blocks (Panel.jsx:1273 quick mode, 1337 masterpiece mode) are nested inside this form. GarmentAddForm renders as a plain `<div onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}>` (not `<form>`), containing a bare `<input type="text">` and SettingsNumberInput fields with no ancestor <form> of their own — so without interception, native browser 'implicit submission' on Enter would target the outer form and fire handleSaveSettings. handleKeyDown calls event.preventDefault() on the container's keydown handler (bubble-phase, before the browser's default action for the key is processed), which reliably cancels the implicit submission — this is the standard, well-established React idiom for this exact problem. Add button is `type="button"` with a manual onClick, so it never triggers native submission either. Claim holds.

claims_verified.claim: onAddGarment receives name.trim() and real numbers (not strings), matching Task 2's handler contract
claims_verified.evidence: GarmentAddForm.handleAdd: `const name = draft.name.trim();` ... `onAddGarment(name, { base_minutes: Number(draft.base_minutes), complexity_coeff: Number(draft.complexity_coeff), quick_price: Number(draft.quick_price) })`. Task 2's handleAddGarment (Panel.jsx:883-891) doc comment explicitly states the contract: 'name передавать уже обрезанным (name.trim())' and stores `fields` as-is into `garments[name]`. Numbers are only computed after validateGarmentFields already confirmed each raw string is a valid positive finite number (toFiniteNumber/isPositiveNumber in Panel.jsx:227-240), so Number() conversion at that point is safe and non-lossy. Matches exactly.

claims_verified.claim: Validation errors are field-specific and match validateGarmentFields's bounds
claims_verified.evidence:
validateGarmentFields (Panel.jsx:264-276) checks base_minutes/complexity_coeff/quick_price each via isPositiveNumber (strict > 0, NaN-safe via toFiniteNumber), matching user-spec AC 'Мин. цена/шт > 0, База/мин > 0, Коэфф. сложности > 0' and tech-spec's backend-bound cross-check (costing.go save-time base_minutes>0/complexity_coeff>0, and the stricter quick-calc-time quick_price>0 requirement folded into the same >0 check here). GarmentAddForm displays `Object.values(errors).join('. ')` — each error message is per-field ('База/мин должна быть больше 0', etc.), concatenated into one visible

. This satisfies the task's own instruction ('no existing error-styling precedent... a plain

... is sufficient') and the AC's requirement of a visible, specific error — it does not claim per-field inline highlighting, which was never required.

claims_verified.claim: DeleteRowButton gated correctly on !DEFAULT_GARMENT_NAMES.includes(name) in both mode branches
claims_verified.evidence: Both call sites present and identical: quick-mode row block (Panel.jsx ~1163 in diff / current file quick Изделия section) and masterpiece-mode row block (~1226 in diff), each `<DeleteRowButton isDeletable={!DEFAULT_GARMENT_NAMES.includes(name)} onDelete={() => handleDeleteGarment(name)} />`. DEFAULT_GARMENT_NAMES (Panel.jsx:101) = exactly the 4 names from user-spec/tech-spec (Пиджак, Юбка, Рубашка, Платье), defined by Task 2 per Decision 6 cross-check against server DefaultUserSettings() — not derived from the stale defaultSettings constant.

claims_verified.claim: No code duplication between quick-mode and masterpiece-mode wiring beyond what's structurally necessary
claims_verified.evidence: The only duplicated lines are the two identical `<GarmentAddForm settings={settings} onAddGarment={handleAddGarment} />` call sites and the two identical DeleteRowButton one-liners inside each mode's pre-existing `.map(...)` row block. This is the exact, minimal duplication mandated by tech-spec Decision 5 (component defined once, invoked at both existing per-mode render sites, mirroring the file's existing DiscountsBlock precedent) — the two mode branches render genuinely different field subsets per row (pre-existing structure, correctly left untouched), so no further sharing is possible without an out-of-scope refactor of the mode-branch structure itself.
